India inks ₹1,976 crore deal with Israel for Navy missile upgrade

India has signed a contract worth ₹1,976 crore with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) to upgrade the Barak Point Defence Missile System for the Indian Navy. The deal, signed under the Other Capital Procurement Procedure, aims to manage obsolescence and upgrade the hardware and software of the ship-borne surface-to-air missile system. The upgrade is valued at approximately $211 million.
